# Real estate guidance in Columbus, GA and East Alabama

Your Home Journey Starts Here.

Buying or selling a property brings decisions you should not have to guess your way through. What can you afford? What should you fix before listing? How do you line up a sale with your next move?

I'm April Johnson, REALTOR® with 1st Class Real Estate Excellence. I help buyers and sellers throughout East Alabama and West Georgia understand their options and decide what comes next.

**Top CTAs:** [Find a home](/buy/) | [Plan your home sale](/sell/)

## Start with what you need to do

### Buying a home

Tell me what you need from the property, where you want to look and when you hope to move. I'll help you work through the search and the questions that come with it. Start with [buyer representation](/buy/) or explore [homes for sale](/homes/).

### Selling a home

You need more than a suggested asking price. You need a plan for preparing the property, marketing it and considering offers. My [seller services](/sell/) focus on those decisions and your reasons for moving.

**Middle CTA:** [Request a home-value conversation](/home-value/)

## Support for the move you are making

As a U.S. Army veteran and Military Relocation Professional, I understand that a move can involve more than changing addresses. Explore [military relocation support](/military-relocation/) if you are moving to or from Fort Benning.

I also help with land, investment properties and new construction. We can start with the property you have in mind or the questions you have not answered yet.

## Local service on both sides of the state line

My service areas include Columbus, Phenix City, Smiths Station, Auburn, Opelika, Harris County and the communities surrounding Fort Benning. Visit [areas I serve](/communities/) to discuss your search or property location.

## Ask the question that is holding you back

You do not need every answer before reaching out. Tell me whether you are buying, selling or figuring out how to do both.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does April Johnson work with both buyers and sellers?

Yes. I represent buyers and sellers, including clients purchasing their first home, selling a property, relocating or exploring land and investment opportunities.

### Can one agent help me compare Columbus and Phenix City?

I am licensed in Georgia and Alabama and serve both areas. Tell me your preferred locations and property requirements so we can discuss the search.

### Where do I start if I need to buy and sell?

Start with a conversation about the property you own, your next purchase and your timing. We can identify which decisions need attention first.

### Does April help with moves to Fort Benning?

Yes. Military relocation is part of my practice. I am a U.S. Army veteran and hold the Military Relocation Professional certification.

### Can I ask questions before deciding to move?

Yes. Tell me what you are considering and what you need to understand before taking the next step.
**End CTA:** [Talk with April about your next move](/contact/)

body:
# A buyer agent for your Columbus, GA home search

You may know the kind of home you want without knowing how to get from browsing to buying. You may also be worried about choosing too quickly, overlooking a problem or taking on more than you intended.

I help buyers in Columbus, Phenix City and surrounding East Alabama and West Georgia communities work through those decisions with clear communication.

**Top CTA:** [Request a buyer consultation](/contact/?intent=buy)

## Build a search around your priorities

Start with the details that affect how you use a home: layout, bedrooms, storage, outdoor space, maintenance preferences and the places you need to reach. Tell me which requirements are essential and where you have room to compromise.

If you are still exploring locations, use the [service-area guide](/communities/) to start a conversation about the areas you want to compare.

## Bring your questions into the process early

### Understand your buying budget

Before choosing a search range, write down the monthly payment and upfront costs you want to discuss with your lender. Bring those questions into our conversation so the property search reflects your financing plans.

### Look beyond the listing photos

A listing is a starting point for questions. Tell me what you want to understand about the property before you decide whether to pursue it. I can help you organize those questions as we move through the buying process.

**Middle CTA:** [Tell me what you are looking for](/contact/?intent=buy)

## Choose the support that fits your purchase

For a first purchase, start with the [first-time buyer guide](/first-time-buyers/). If you are considering a newly built home, explore [new-construction representation](/new-construction/). If your move involves Fort Benning, visit [military relocation](/military-relocation/).

## Buying while selling?

Tell me about both properties at the beginning. We can discuss your selling plans alongside your search instead of treating them as unrelated decisions. Read about [selling your current home](/sell/).

## Make your next step specific

Share your preferred areas, property requirements and intended timeframe. If you already have a listing in mind, include its address or link.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I start buying a home in Columbus, GA?

Begin with your preferred areas, property requirements and intended timeframe. Discuss financing questions with your lender and request a buyer consultation to plan the search.

### Can April help me buy in Phenix City, Alabama?

Yes. Phenix City is one of my service areas, and I am licensed in Alabama and Georgia.

### Can I buy a home while selling my current property?

Tell me about both parts of the move. We can discuss the sequence you are considering and the questions to resolve before you commit to a plan.

### What should I bring to a buyer consultation?

Bring your preferred locations, must-have features, timing and any listings that interest you. Include your budget questions and whether you also need to sell.

### Does April work with first-time buyers?

Yes. I help first-time buyers understand their options, ask questions and work through the homebuying process.
**End CTA:** [Start your home search with April](/contact/?intent=buy)

# Sell your house in Columbus, GA with a clear plan

Before you list, you want to know what your property could sell for, what needs attention and how the sale fits your next move. You may be weighing repairs against cost or wondering whether to sell before buying again.

I help homeowners in Columbus, Phenix City and surrounding communities work through pricing, marketing and negotiations.

**Top CTA:** [Request a seller consultation](/contact/?intent=sell)

## Start with the property and your priorities

Tell me why you are considering a sale, when you would like to move and what concerns you most. Share the property's address, condition and updates so we can have a useful conversation about the next steps.

If pricing is your first question, [request a home-value review](/home-value/).

## Decide what to address before listing

### Preparation with a purpose

Before committing to a long improvement list, let's discuss the property and the presentation you want buyers to see. My interest in interior design and staging informs the way I help sellers think about preparing their homes.

### Marketing that explains the property

A marketing plan should communicate the property's features clearly. We can discuss how to present the layout, condition and other relevant details, along with [CONFIRMED MARKETING SERVICES].

**Middle CTA:** [Discuss your property's pricing and preparation](/contact/?intent=sell)

## Understand the offer before making the decision

When an offer arrives, you need to understand the proposed price, terms and timing. I provide guidance through negotiations and the selling process so you can ask questions before deciding how to respond.

## Keep the next move in view

If you also need to buy, tell me early. Visit [buyer representation](/buy/) to see how we can discuss both parts of the move. If your sale is connected to military orders, explore [PCS relocation support](/military-relocation/).

## Tell me about the home you are considering selling

Start with the address and your intended timeframe. You can also tell me what you are unsure about, including preparation, pricing or coordinating a purchase.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much can I sell my Columbus, GA house for?

I need to review the property before discussing a suggested price. Send its address, condition and recent updates through the home-value request form.

### What should I fix before selling my home?

Bring your repair and improvement list to a seller consultation. We can discuss your priorities before you commit to work. No specific repair return is promised.

### How long will it take to sell my home?

I cannot give you a reliable timeline without reviewing your property and current conditions. Tell me your target move date so we can discuss it when planning the sale.

### What does April include in her listing services?

My work includes guidance on pricing, marketing strategies, negotiations and the selling process. We will discuss the specific marketing services and representation terms for your property.

### Can April help me sell a property in Phenix City?

Yes. I work with sellers in Phenix City as well as Columbus and other areas in my Alabama and Georgia service markets.
**End CTA:** [Let's plan your home sale](/contact/?intent=sell)

# What is your Columbus, GA home worth?

You may be ready to list, comparing your options or trying to understand whether a sale would support your next move. Start with your property, not an assumed price.

Send me the address and a few details. We can discuss pricing in the context of your home and your plans.

**Top CTA:** [Request my home-value review](#valuation-request)

## Tell me what a listing photo would miss

Your property's condition, updates and features deserve a conversation. Include the changes you have made and anything you think needs attention. If you are not sure what matters, start with what you know.

This is a request for a personal pricing conversation. It is not an instant automated valuation, an appraisal or a promise of a particular sale price.

## Use the conversation to plan your next step

### If you want to sell soon

Share your preferred timeframe and any plans to purchase another property. We can discuss pricing alongside preparation and your [home-selling plan](/sell/).

### If you are still deciding

Tell me what you need to understand before committing to a move. The first conversation can focus on your questions.

**Middle CTA:** [Ask April about your property's value](#valuation-request)

## Home-value request

[FORM ANCHOR: valuation-request]

**Form heading:** Tell me about your property.

**Fields:** Property address; name; email or phone; preferred contact method; selling timeframe. Optional: updates, condition and questions.

**Submit button:** Request my home-value review

**Helper text:** Share the property details you have. Please do not include account numbers, loan documents or other sensitive records.

**Success message, only after delivery:** Your request has been sent. April has the property details you submitted.

**Error message:** Your request was not sent. Please try again or use the contact page.

## Selling in Alabama or elsewhere in my service area?

I also work with sellers in Phenix City and other East Alabama and West Georgia communities. See [the areas I serve](/communities/) or [ask about your property](/contact/?intent=sell).

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I find out what my Columbus home is worth?

Submit your address and property details to request a pricing conversation. Include recent updates, condition and your intended selling timeframe.

### Will this form give me an instant home value?

No. This form requests a personal review and conversation. It does not generate an instant price.

### Is a home-value review an appraisal?

No. This request is for a real estate pricing conversation, not an appraisal.

### Can I request a value review for a Phenix City property?

Yes. I work with sellers in Phenix City and other locations within my Alabama and Georgia service markets.

### What if I do not plan to sell right away?

Tell me that when you submit your request. We can focus the conversation on what you want to understand before making a decision.
**End CTA:** [Start my property review](#valuation-request)

# Buying your first home in Columbus, GA

You do not need to know the vocabulary before asking for help. If you are unsure where to begin, what to ask a lender or how to compare properties, start there.

I work with first-time buyers in Columbus, Phenix City and the surrounding service areas. My approach is to explain the process, welcome questions and help you understand your options.

**Top CTA:** [Talk about buying your first home](/contact/?intent=first-home)

## Put your questions ahead of the search

### What would make a purchase work for you?

Think about your timing, the money questions you need answered and the features you need from a property. You can bring an incomplete list. We will use it to identify the next questions.

### What do you want to ask about financing?

Write down questions about upfront funds, monthly payments and loan options for your lender. If you are unsure whether an assistance program applies to you, ask for current eligibility and availability details instead of assuming you qualify.

## Make room for uncertainty

It is reasonable to worry about overlooking something or making a decision before you understand it. Tell me when a step is unclear. Education and communication are central to the way I work with buyers.

**Middle CTA:** [Bring April your homebuying questions](/contact/?intent=first-home)

## Search with a purpose

Your first shortlist does not have to be long. Start with a few properties and explain what interests you about each one. Visit [the property search](/homes/) and keep notes on the layout, condition and features you want to discuss.

Read about [buyer representation](/buy/) for the broader process. If military relocation is part of your purchase, visit [Fort Benning relocation support](/military-relocation/).

## Start with one conversation

Tell me where you hope to buy, when you hope to move and which part feels least clear. We can begin with that question.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where should a first-time buyer in Columbus, GA begin?

Start with your timing, property priorities and financing questions. A buyer consultation gives us a place to organize those questions before you narrow the search.

### How much money do I need to buy my first home?

Bring this question to your lender along with the price range you are considering. I have not published a required amount because your financing and transaction details need individual review.

### Are first-time buyer programs available to me?

Eligibility and availability need to be checked for your situation. Ask your lender about current options. No program or approval is promised on this website.

### Can April help first-time buyers in Phenix City?

Yes. I work with first-time buyers in Phenix City as well as Columbus and other areas I serve.

### What if I am not ready to choose a property?

You can still ask questions. Tell me what you need to understand before deciding whether to move forward.
**End CTA:** [Request my first-home consultation](/contact/?intent=first-home)

# Buyer representation for new construction in Phenix City and Columbus

A new home can leave you with a different set of questions. What is included? Which decisions still need to be made? How will the expected completion date fit your move?

I work with buyers interested in new construction throughout my East Alabama and West Georgia service markets.

**Top CTA:** [Discuss a new-construction purchase](/contact/?intent=new-construction)

## Start with the home and the details you need

Bring the community name, property address or builder information you have. Tell me whether you are considering an available home or a home that has not been completed.

If you are still searching, share your preferred location and property requirements. Visit [the property search](/homes/) to begin exploring.

## Get your questions in order

### Features and selections

Write down which features matter most to you. Ask what the quoted price includes, what is optional and where those details are recorded.

### Timing and your next move

Share your intended move date and any property you need to sell. Ask which dates are estimates and what happens if plans change.

### Representation and agreements

Tell me where you are in the process, including whether you have visited a builder or signed anything. We can discuss the representation available for your situation.

New construction is one part of my [buyer representation](/buy/) work. If the purchase also involves a sale, explore [selling your current home](/sell/). If you want to buy land first, visit [land and acreage](/land/).

You do not need to have selected a builder to reach out. Tell me your preferred area, timing and the decisions you need help organizing.

Yes. New-construction buyer representation is part of my real estate practice in my Alabama and Georgia service markets.

Tell me what you have visited and whether you have signed any documents. We can discuss your position and the next questions to address.

Ask for the current written details for the specific property. Send me the home or community you are considering so we can discuss the questions you want answered.

Yes. I work with both buyers and sellers. Tell me about the property you own and your purchase plans so we can discuss the timing together.

# Real estate support for your Fort Benning military relocation

A move connected to military service comes with questions about timing, housing and what happens next. You may be buying from a distance, deciding what to do with a home you own or trying to coordinate several parts of a move.

I'm April Johnson, a U.S. Army veteran and Military Relocation Professional. I help buyers and sellers relocating to or from Fort Benning and surrounding communities.

**Top CTA:** [Discuss my relocation](/contact/?intent=military-relocation)

## Start with your timeline and your questions

Tell me when you expect to move, whether you need to buy or sell and which details are still uncertain. You do not need to share orders or sensitive service documents through a website form.

## Buying during a relocation

### Define the property requirements

Focus on the features you need, your preferred search areas and the locations you need to reach. Share any limits on when you can visit so we can discuss how to approach the search.

### Bring financing questions to the right conversation

If you are considering VA financing, ask your lender about eligibility, costs and the requirements for your purchase. My role is to help with your real estate search and representation. Loan approval is not promised here.

**Middle CTA:** [Plan my home search around my move](/contact/?intent=military-relocation)

## Selling before your next move

Share your expected departure timeframe and any questions about pricing or preparation. We can discuss a [home-selling plan](/sell/) that accounts for the decisions you need to make. No particular sale date is guaranteed.

## Compare the areas you want to consider

I serve Columbus, Phenix City, Smiths Station and other East Alabama and West Georgia communities. Use [areas I serve](/communities/) to begin discussing locations. Bring the actual destinations and travel requirements you want to evaluate rather than relying on a general commute promise.

## Make the next step manageable

Tell me what is confirmed and what could change. We can begin with the housing decision that needs attention first.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does April help with PCS moves to Fort Benning?

Yes. I help buyers and sellers relocating to or from Fort Benning and the surrounding communities.

### What military relocation experience does April bring?

I am a U.S. Army veteran and hold the Military Relocation Professional certification. Communication and attention to detail are central to my approach.

### Can I begin a home search before arriving in the area?

Yes. Start by sharing your preferred locations, property requirements and expected arrival timeframe. We can discuss how to approach the search and your availability.

### Can I use a VA loan to buy a home near Fort Benning?

Discuss your eligibility and the specific purchase with a lender who handles VA financing. I can help with the real estate search, but I do not determine loan eligibility.

### Can April help sell my home when I receive new orders?

Yes. Tell me about the property and your expected timing so we can discuss pricing, preparation and the selling process.
**End CTA:** [Request a relocation consultation](/contact/?intent=military-relocation)

# Buying and selling land in East Alabama and West Georgia

You may have a particular use in mind for a parcel without knowing whether the property supports it. Or you may own land and need help deciding how to present it for sale.

I work with clients buying and selling residential lots, vacant land and acreage within my Alabama and Georgia service markets.

**Top CTA:** [Discuss a land purchase or sale](/contact/?intent=land)

## Start with what you want to do with the property

Tell me the location, approximate size you are considering and intended use. If you already have a parcel in mind, send its address, parcel identifier or listing link.

### Ask property-specific questions

Before treating a parcel as a fit, identify the questions that need answers. Your list may include access, boundaries, utilities, restrictions and permitted use. Ask for the relevant records and confirmation from the appropriate professionals or authorities.

An attractive listing photograph is not confirmation that a parcel can be used the way you intend.

# Meet April Johnson, REALTOR®

You should feel comfortable asking your real estate agent a question, including the one you think you should already know the answer to.

I'm April Johnson with 1st Class Real Estate Excellence. I am licensed in Alabama and Georgia and work with buyers and sellers throughout East Alabama and West Georgia.

**Top CTA:** [Talk with April](/contact/)

## A personal approach to real estate

My work is about helping you understand your options. Whether you are buying a first home, preparing to sell or considering an investment, I want you to feel informed about the decisions in front of you.

That means listening to what you need, explaining the process and making room for questions. Your timeline, concerns and priorities belong in the conversation from the beginning.

## Experience that shapes how I work

### Military service and relocation

I am a U.S. Army veteran and hold the Military Relocation Professional certification. My military background informs my commitment to communication, attention to detail and following through.

I understand that relocation can involve uncertainty. Learn more about my [military relocation services](/military-relocation/).

### Education and property presentation

I hold a master's degree in Acquisition Management. I also have an interest in interior design and staging, which informs the way I discuss property presentation with sellers and possibilities with buyers.

**Middle CTA:** [Tell me what you need from your agent](/contact/)

## Buying and selling deserve equal attention

I help buyers find a property and work through the purchasing process. I also help sellers with pricing, marketing strategies and negotiations. Explore [buying with April](/buy/) or [planning your sale](/sell/).

My practice includes land, investment properties and new construction within my service markets.

## Beyond real estate

Outside work, I enjoy time with family and friends, volunteering in my community, working out and reading about market trends.

Yes. I am licensed in both Alabama and Georgia and work with 1st Class Real Estate Excellence.

I work with 1st Class Real Estate Excellence.

Yes. I work with both buyers and sellers, including land, investment properties and new construction within my service markets.
